author: Hoon Kim
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content: **Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator** We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds. Quality level matching the attached characters Requirements: - Japanese anime art style (see attached images) - Experience with 2D game character art - Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors) To apply: Send your portfolio. Feel free to reach out!

author: Nellyslife
title: HIRING: Freelance Illustrator & Graphic Designer (Philippines)
content: HIRING: Freelance Illustrator & Graphic Designer (Philippines) Remote · Project-based · Start ASAP Apply by email only: team.nellyslife@gmail.com Send your portfolio, rates and availability, with the subject line “Freelance Illustrator / Designer – [Your Name]”. DMs and comments won’t be considered. We are seeking a versatile Illustrator to join our team on a contract basis. Remote Work Setup Minimum of 1 to 3 months. Starting at Php 35,000 for the first month, with the potential to increase to Php 45,000. Create high-quality small designs per week based on provided concept statements.
